question: Electric current is measured by
question_hi: विद्युत धारा मापी जाती है :
solution:
Correct Answer: Electric current is measured by Ammeter
Rationale:
  • Electric current is the flow of electric charge in a circuit, usually carried by electrons in a conductor. Measuring this flow is crucial for understanding and analyzing electrical systems.
  • An ammeter is a device specifically designed to measure the electric current flowing through a circuit. It is connected in series with the circuit so that all the current passes through the ammeter, ensuring an accurate reading.
  • Ammeters are calibrated to measure current in units of amperes (A), and they are essential in various applications, from electronics to industrial equipment, to monitor and control electrical systems.
  • Modern ammeters are often digital, providing precise readings, although analog versions with a needle and scale are still used in specific settings.
Explanation of Other Options:
Anemometer
  • Rationale: Anemometers are devices used to measure wind speed. They are commonly used in meteorology and have no relevance to measuring electric current.
Voltmeter
  • Rationale: A voltmeter is used to measure the voltage or potential difference between two points in a circuit, not the current. It is connected in parallel with the component whose voltage is being measured.
Commutator
  • Rationale: A commutator is a mechanical device in electric motors and generators that reverses the direction of current flow. It is not a measuring instrument and cannot measure electric current.
Conclusion:
  • The ammeter is the correct tool for measuring electric current, as it is designed for this specific purpose. Other options, such as the anemometer, voltmeter, and commutator, are used in entirely different contexts and are not suitable for measuring current.

तर्क:
  • विद्युत धारा एक परिपथ में विद्युत आवेश का प्रवाह है, जो आमतौर पर एक चालक में इलेक्ट्रॉनों द्वारा किया जाता है। इस प्रवाह को मापना विद्युत प्रणालियों को समझने और उनका विश्लेषण करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।
  • एक एमीटर एक उपकरण है जिसे विशेष रूप से परिपथ के माध्यम से प्रवाहित विद्युत धारा को मापने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह परिपथ के साथ शृंखला में जुड़ा होता है ताकि धारा एमीटर से होकर गुजरे, जिससे सटीक पठन सुनिश्चित हो सके।
  • एमीटर को एम्पीयर (A) की इकाइयों में धारा को मापने के लिए अंशांकित किया जाता है, और वे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स से लेकर औद्योगिक उपकरणों तक, विद्युत प्रणालियों की निगरानी और नियंत्रण के लिए विभिन्न अनुप्रयोगों में आवश्यक हैं।
  • आधुनिक एमीटर अक्सर डिजिटल होते हैं, जो सटीक पठन  प्रदान करते हैं, हालांकि सुई और स्केल वाले एनालॉग संस्करण अभी भी विशिष्ट सेटिंग्स में उपयोग किए जाते हैं।
अन्य विकल्पों की व्याख्या:
एनीमोमीटर 
  • तर्क: एनीमोमीटर ऐसे उपकरण हैं जिनका उपयोग वायु की गति को मापने के लिए किया जाता है। इनका उपयोग आमतौर पर मौसम विज्ञान में किया जाता है और विद्युत धारा को मापने से इनका कोई संबंध नहीं है।
वोल्टमीटर
  • तर्क: एक वोल्टमीटर का उपयोग परिपथ में दो बिंदुओं के बीच वोल्टेज या संभावित अंतर को मापने के लिए किया जाता है, न कि धारा को। यह उस घटक के समानांतर जुड़ा होता है जिसके वोल्टेज को मापा जा रहा है।
दिक्परिवर्तक
  • तर्क: एक दिक्परिवर्तक विद्युत मोटर्स और जनरेटर में एक यांत्रिक उपकरण है जो धारा प्रवाह की दिशा को उलट देता है। यह एक मापने का उपकरण नहीं है और विद्युत धारा को नहीं माप सकता है।
निष्कर्ष:
  • एमीटर विद्युत धारा को मापने के लिए सही उपकरण है, क्योंकि इसे इस विशिष्ट उद्देश्य के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। अन्य विकल्प, जैसे एनीमोमीटर, वोल्टमीटर और दिक्परिवर्तक, पूरी तरह से अलग संदर्भों में उपयोग किए जाते हैं और धारा को मापने के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

question: What is the instrument used to measure high temperatures in the furnace?
question_hi: भट्टी में उच्च तापमान को मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
solution:
The correct answer is Pyrometer.

Key Points

  • A pyrometer is an instrument used for measuring high temperatures, typically in industrial furnaces, kilns, and other heating devices.
  • Pyrometers function by detecting the radiation emitted by a hot object, often using infrared technology for non-contact temperature measurement.
  • They are widely used in industries such as metallurgy, glass manufacturing, ceramics, and power plants to ensure temperature regulation and safety.
  • Pyrometers can measure temperatures ranging from 700°C to over 4000°C, depending on the type and design of the instrument.
  • Modern pyrometers are equipped with digital displays and advanced features like data logging, adjustable emissivity, and remote sensing capabilities for precision measurement.

Additional Information

  • Fathometer
    • A fathometer is an instrument used to measure the depth of water bodies, such as seas and oceans.
    • It works on the principle of echo sounding, where sound waves are transmitted into the water and their reflections are measured to determine depth.
    • This device is commonly used in marine navigation, fishing, and underwater exploration.
  • Salinometer
    • A salinometer is a device used to measure the salinity or salt concentration in water, particularly in oceanography and marine studies.
    • It helps assess the quality of water and is widely used in industries like aquaculture, desalination plants, and environmental monitoring.
  • Manometer
    • A manometer is an instrument used to measure the pressure of gases or liquids.
    • It typically consists of a U-shaped tube filled with a liquid, often mercury or water, to indicate pressure difference.
    • Manometers are widely used in laboratories, HVAC systems, and industrial processes for pressure monitoring and control.
  • Theme: Temperature Measurement
    • Temperature measurement is a critical aspect of industrial and scientific processes.
    • Different instruments like pyrometers, thermocouples, and infrared sensors are used based on the application and temperature range.
    • Accurate temperature measurement ensures safe operations, energy efficiency, and product quality in various industries.

question: The instrument used for detecting electric current is __________.
question_hi: विद्युत धारा (करंट) का पता लगाने के लिए __________ उपकरण प्रयोग में लाया जाता है।
solution:
The correct answer is Galvanometer.

Key Points

  • A galvanometer is an instrument used to detect and measure small electric currents by deflection of a pointer.
  • It operates based on the principle of electromagnetic deflection, which occurs when a current-carrying coil is placed in a magnetic field.
  • The deflection of the needle in the galvanometer is proportional to the current flowing through it, making it highly sensitive.
  • Galvanometers are used in electrical and electronic laboratories to test circuits and detect the presence of current.
  • Modern galvanometers are often used as the core mechanism for devices such as analog ammeters and voltmeters.

Additional Information

  • Altimeter
    • An altimeter is an instrument used to measure the altitude or height of an object above a fixed level, often sea level.
    • It is commonly used in aviation, mountaineering, and skydiving to determine elevation.
    • Altimeters work by measuring atmospheric pressure, which decreases with altitude, and converting it into height readings.
  • Fathometer
    • A fathometer is a depth-measuring device used to determine the depth of water beneath a ship or boat.
    • It works using the principle of echo sounding, where sound waves are emitted and the time taken for the echo to return is measured.
    • Fathometers are vital in marine navigation and underwater exploration.
  • Tube Tester
    • A tube tester is a device used to test the functionality and performance of vacuum tubes.
    • It is widely used in audio equipment repair and restoration, particularly for vintage devices using vacuum tube technology.
    • Tube testers assess parameters such as tube gain, emission, and transconductance.

question: Name the device ................... which can detect the presence of electric current in a circuit
question_hi: उस उपकरण का नाम बताइए जो किसी सर्किट में विद्युत धारा की उपस्थिति का पता लगा सकता है
solution:
The correct answer is Galvanometer.

Key Points

  • Galvanometer is an instrument used to detect the presence of electric current in a circuit.
  • It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction, where a magnetic needle deflects when electric current passes through a coil.
  • A galvanometer is highly sensitive and can detect even small amounts of current.
  • It is mainly used in laboratories and electrical experiments to measure current direction and intensity.
  • Modern galvanometers are often used as a component in devices like ammeters or voltmeters.

Additional Information

  • Voltmeter
    • A voltmeter is a device used to measure the voltage or potential difference between two points in an electrical circuit.
    • It is connected in parallel to the component whose voltage is to be measured.
    • Unlike the galvanometer, it does not detect the presence of current but measures the voltage.
    • The voltmeter is specially designed to have high resistance to minimize current flow through it during operation.
  • Generator
    • A generator is a device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy using electromagnetic induction.
    • It is commonly used in power generation and backup systems.
    • Generators do not detect current; instead, they produce current by rotating a coil in a magnetic field.
    • They are essential for electricity generation in homes, industries, and power plants.
  • Motor
    • A motor is a device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
    • It works on the principle of the motor effect, where the force acts on a current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field.
    • Motors are widely used in household appliances, vehicles, and industrial machinery.

  • इसका उपयोग मुख्य रूप से प्रयोगशालाओं और विद्युत प्रयोगों में धारा की दिशा और तीव्रता को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
  • आधुनिक गैल्वेनोमीटर का उपयोग अक्सर एमीटर या वोल्टमीटर जैसे उपकरणों में एक घटक के रूप में किया जाता है।

अतिरिक्त जानकारी

  • वोल्टमीटर
    • एक वोल्टमीटर एक उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग विद्युत परिपथ में दो बिंदुओं के बीच वोल्टेज या संभावित अंतर को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
    • यह उस घटक के समानांतर जुड़ा होता है जिसके वोल्टेज को मापा जाना है।
    • गैल्वेनोमीटर के विपरीत, यह धारा की उपस्थिति का पता नहीं लगाता है, लेकिन वोल्टेज को मापता है।
    • वोल्टमीटर विशेष रूप से संचालन के दौरान इसके माध्यम से धारा प्रवाह को कम करने के लिए उच्च प्रतिरोध करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।
  • जनरेटर
    • एक जनरेटर एक उपकरण है जो विद्युत चुम्बकीय प्रेरण का उपयोग करके यांत्रिक ऊर्जा को विद्युत ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करता है।
    • यह आमतौर पर बिजली उत्पादन और बैकअप सिस्टम में उपयोग किया जाता है।
    • जनरेटर धारा का पता नहीं लगाते हैं; इसके बजाय, वे चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में एक कुंडल को घुमाकर धारा उत्पन्न करते हैं।
    • वे घरों, उद्योगों और बिजली संयंत्रों में बिजली उत्पादन के लिए आवश्यक हैं।
  • मोटर
    • एक मोटर एक उपकरण है जो विद्युत ऊर्जा को यांत्रिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करता है।
    • यह मोटर प्रभाव के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है, जहां एक चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में रखे धारा-ले जाने वाले कंडक्टर पर बल कार्य करता है।
    • मोटरों का व्यापक रूप से घरेलू उपकरणों, वाहनों और औद्योगिक मशीनरी में उपयोग किया जाता है।

question: What is the height of the mercury column in a barometer at sea level?
question_hi: समुद्र तल पर बेरोमीटर में पारा स्तंभ की ऊंचाई कितनी होती है?
solution:
The correct answer is 76 cm.

Key Points

  • A barometer measures atmospheric pressure using a column of mercury in a glass tube.
  • At sea level, the standard atmospheric pressure is equivalent to the pressure exerted by a 76 cm column of mercury.
  • This value corresponds to one atmosphere (1 atm) of pressure, which is approximately 101,325 Pascals or 760 mmHg.
  • The height of the mercury column is influenced by the surrounding atmospheric pressure, which decreases at higher altitudes.
  • The 76 cm measurement is based on standard conditions (temperature of 0°C and normal gravity).

Additional Information

  • Barometer and Atmospheric Pressure
    • A barometer is a crucial instrument in meteorology and is used to predict weather changes by measuring atmospheric pressure.
    • Mercury barometers work on the principle that atmospheric pressure balances the weight of a column of mercury.
    • The standard height of 76 cm for the mercury column is used as a reference for 1 atmosphere (atm) at sea level under standard conditions.
    • Variations in the column height indicate changes in atmospheric pressure, which are used to predict weather patterns such as storms or fair weather.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर 76 सेमी है।

मुख्य बिंदु

  • बैरोमीटर एक कांच की ट्यूब में पारा के स्तंभ का उपयोग करके वायुमंडलीय दबाव को मापता है।
  • समुद्र तल पर, मानक वायुमंडलीय दबाव 76 सेमी पारा के स्तंभ द्वारा लगाए गए दबाव के बराबर होता है।
  • यह मान दबाव के एक वायुमंडल (1 एटीएम) से मेल खाता है, जो लगभग 101,325 पास्कल या 760 mmHg है।
  • पारे के स्तंभ की ऊंचाई आसपास के वायुमंडलीय दबाव से प्रभावित होती है, जो अधिक ऊंचाई पर घट जाती है।
  • 76 सेमी माप मानक स्थितियों (0 डिग्री सेल्सियस का तापमान और सामान्य गुरुत्वाकर्षण) पर आधारित है।

अतिरिक्त जानकारी

  • बैरोमीटर और वायुमंडलीय दबाव
    • बैरोमीटर मौसम विज्ञान में एक महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण है और इसका उपयोग वायुमंडलीय दबाव को मापकर मौसम में बदलाव की भविष्यवाणी करने के लिए किया जाता है।
    • पारा बैरोमीटर इस सिद्धांत पर काम करते हैं कि वायुमंडलीय दबाव पारे के स्तंभ के वजन को संतुलित करता है।
    • पारे के स्तंभ की मानक ऊंचाई 76 सेमी का उपयोग मानक परिस्थितियों में समुद्र तल पर 1 वायुमंडल (atm) के संदर्भ के रूप में किया जाता है।
    • स्तंभ की ऊंचाई में बदलाव वायुमंडलीय दबाव में बदलाव का संकेत देते हैं, जिनका उपयोग तूफान या अच्छे मौसम जैसे मौसम के पैटर्न की भविष्यवाणी करने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: Which of the following is a common calibration method for electrical measuring instruments?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों के लिए एक सामान्य अंशांकन विधि है?
solution:
In the context of electrical measuring instruments, the correct calibration and measurement method among the choices is the Null method.

Explanation:

The null method is a highly accurate calibration technique where the measurement is made by balancing the unknown quantity against a known standard until the net effect is zero (the "null" point).

Shutterstock

  • Principle: It operates on the principle of opposition, where the difference between the measured value and the reference value is brought to zero.

  • Accuracy: Because it seeks a zero-point balance, it eliminates errors caused by the internal resistance of the measuring instrument (like a galvanometer).

  • Examples:

    • Wheatstone Bridge: Used for measuring unknown electrical resistance.

    • Potentiometer: Used for measuring the electromotive force (EMF) of a cell.
solution_hi:

शून्य विधि एक अत्यधिक सटीक अंशांकन तकनीक है जहां अज्ञात मात्रा को ज्ञात मानक के विरुद्ध संतुलित करके माप किया जाता है जब तक कि शुद्ध प्रभाव शून्य न हो जाए ("शून्य" बिंदु)।

  • सटीकता: क्योंकि यह एक शून्य-बिंदु संतुलन की तलाश करता है, यह मापने वाले उपकरण (जैसे गैल्वेनोमीटर) के आंतरिक प्रतिरोध के कारण होने वाली त्रुटियों को समाप्त करता है।

  • उदाहरण:

    • व्हीटस्टोन सेतु: अज्ञात विद्युत प्रतिरोध को मापने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

question: Which of the following is a switching error in electrical measuring instruments?
question_hi: विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी स्विचिंग त्रुटि है?
options: Error due to wrong calculation of subdivisions
options_hi: उपखंडों की गलत गणना के कारण त्रुटि
solution:
Explanation:

Switching Errors in Electrical Measuring Instruments

Definition: A switching error in electrical measuring instruments occurs when there is an incorrect connection or configuration of the meter or circuit during measurement. This type of error typically arises due to improper wiring, wrong placement of switches, or incorrect selection of measurement modes.

Working Principle: Electrical measuring instruments operate based on the principle of detecting and quantifying electrical parameters such as voltage, current, resistance, or power. The accuracy of these measurements depends on the proper connection of the instrument in the circuit and the correct selection of the measurement range or mode. If the connections or configurations are wrong, the measured values will be inaccurate, leading to switching errors.

Causes of Switching Errors:

  • Improper Connections: Incorrect wiring or misplacement of the instrument in the circuit can result in switching errors. For example, connecting a voltmeter across a current source or using an ammeter in parallel instead of series can lead to erroneous readings.
  • Wrong Mode Selection: Measuring instruments often have multiple modes, such as AC/DC or voltage/current/resistance. Selecting the wrong mode can cause the instrument to display incorrect values.
  • Human Error: Mistakes made by the operator during setup, such as failing to check the polarity of connections or overlooking the range settings, are common sources of switching errors.

Impact of Switching Errors:

  • Inaccurate measurement results, which can compromise the reliability of electrical systems.
  • Potential damage to the measuring instrument if it is connected incorrectly or used outside its specified range.
  • Safety hazards, such as electrical shocks or short circuits, due to improper connections.

Corrective Measures:

  • Ensure proper wiring and connections based on the instrument’s user manual and circuit diagram.
  • Double-check the mode and range settings before taking measurements.
  • Provide training to operators on the correct usage of electrical measuring instruments to minimize human errors.
  • Use instruments with built-in protection mechanisms, such as overload protection or polarity reversal indicators, to safeguard against switching errors.

Correct Option Analysis:

The correct option is:

Option 1: Wrong connection of the meter.

This option correctly identifies the primary cause of switching errors in electrical measuring instruments. Improper connections, such as connecting the meter to the wrong terminals or reversing polarity, can lead to inaccurate readings or even damage to the instrument. Proper wiring and adherence to connection guidelines are essential to avoid switching errors.

Additional Information

To further understand the analysis, let’s evaluate the other options:

Option 2: Error due to wrong calculation of subdivisions.

This option refers to errors resulting from incorrect interpretation or calculation of measurement scale divisions on analog instruments. While this is a type of human error, it is not classified as a switching error. Switching errors are specifically related to improper connections or configurations.

Option 3: Error due to heat.

Errors caused by heat arise from thermal effects on the measuring instrument, such as changes in resistance or expansion of components. These are categorized as thermal errors rather than switching errors, as they are related to environmental factors and the physical properties of the instrument.

Option 4: Error due to vibration.

Vibration-induced errors occur when the measuring instrument is subjected to mechanical vibrations during operation, leading to instability in readings. These errors are mechanical in nature and do not fall under the category of switching errors.

Conclusion:

Switching errors in electrical measuring instruments are primarily caused by improper connections or configurations of the meter during measurement. This type of error can be prevented by ensuring correct wiring, mode selection, and adherence to operational guidelines. While other types of errors, such as calculation mistakes, thermal effects, or vibrations, can also affect measurement accuracy, they are not classified as switching errors. Proper training and the use of advanced instruments with safety features can significantly reduce the occurrence of switching errors and improve measurement reliability.
solution_hi:
स्पष्टीकरण:

विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों में स्विचिंग त्रुटियां

परिभाषा: विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों में स्विचिंग त्रुटि तब होती है जब माप के दौरान मीटर या सर्किट का गलत कनेक्शन या कॉन्फ़िगरेशन होता है। इस प्रकार की त्रुटि आमतौर पर अनुचित वायरिंग, स्विचों के गलत स्थान या माप मोड के गलत चयन के कारण उत्पन्न होती है।

कार्य सिद्धांत: विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरण वोल्टेज, करंट, प्रतिरोध या शक्ति जैसे विद्युत मापदंडों का पता लगाने और मात्रा निर्धारित करने के सिद्धांत पर काम करते हैं। इन मापों की सटीकता सर्किट में उपकरण के उचित कनेक्शन और माप सीमा या मोड के सही चयन पर निर्भर करती है। यदि कनेक्शन या कॉन्फ़िगरेशन गलत हैं, तो मापे गए मान गलत होंगे, जिससे स्विचिंग त्रुटियां होंगी।

स्विचिंग त्रुटियों के कारण:

  • अनुचित कनेक्शन: सर्किट में गलत वायरिंग या उपकरण का गलत स्थान स्विचिंग त्रुटियों का कारण बन सकता है। उदाहरण के लिए, एक वोल्टमीटर को करंट स्रोत से जोड़ना या एक एमीटर को श्रृंखला के बजाय समानांतर में उपयोग करना गलत रीडिंग का कारण बन सकता है।
  • गलत मोड चयन: मापने वाले उपकरणों में अक्सर कई मोड होते हैं, जैसे AC/DC या वोल्टेज/करंट/प्रतिरोध। गलत मोड का चयन करने से उपकरण गलत मान प्रदर्शित कर सकता है।
  • मानवीय त्रुटि: सेटअप के दौरान ऑपरेटर द्वारा की गई गलतियाँ, जैसे कनेक्शन की ध्रुवता की जाँच करने में विफल रहना या रेंज सेटिंग्स को अनदेखा करना, स्विचिंग त्रुटियों के सामान्य स्रोत हैं।

स्विचिंग त्रुटियों का प्रभाव:

  • गलत माप परिणाम, जो विद्युत प्रणालियों की विश्वसनीयता से समझौता कर सकते हैं।
  • मापने वाले उपकरण को संभावित क्षति यदि यह गलत तरीके से जुड़ा है या अपनी निर्दिष्ट सीमा के बाहर उपयोग किया जाता है।
  • अनुचित कनेक्शन के कारण सुरक्षा खतरे, जैसे बिजली के झटके या शॉर्ट सर्किट।

सुधारात्मक उपाय:

  • उपकरण के उपयोगकर्ता मैनुअल और सर्किट आरेख के आधार पर उचित वायरिंग और कनेक्शन सुनिश्चित करें।
  • माप लेने से पहले मोड और रेंज सेटिंग्स को दोबारा जांचें।
  • मानवीय त्रुटियों को कम करने के लिए ऑपरेटरों को विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों के सही उपयोग पर प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करें।
  • बिल्ट-इन सुरक्षा तंत्र वाले उपकरणों का उपयोग करें, जैसे कि ओवरलोड सुरक्षा या ध्रुवता उत्क्रमण संकेतक, स्विचिंग त्रुटियों से बचाने के लिए।

सही विकल्प विश्लेषण:

सही विकल्प है:

विकल्प 1: मीटर का गलत कनेक्शन।

यह विकल्प विद्युत मापने वाले उपकरणों में स्विचिंग त्रुटियों के प्राथमिक कारण को सही ढंग से पहचानता है। अनुचित कनेक्शन, जैसे कि मीटर को गलत टर्मिनलों से जोड़ना या ध्रुवता को उलटना, गलत रीडिंग या यहां तक कि उपकरण को नुकसान पहुंचा सकता है। स्विचिंग त्रुटियों से बचने के लिए उचित वायरिंग और कनेक्शन दिशानिर्देशों का पालन करना आवश्यक है।

अतिरिक्त जानकारी

विश्लेषण को और समझने के लिए, आइए अन्य विकल्पों का मूल्यांकन करें:

विकल्प 2: उपखंडों की गलत गणना के कारण त्रुटि।

यह विकल्प एनालॉग उपकरणों पर माप पैमाने के विभाजनों की गलत व्याख्या या गणना के परिणामस्वरूप होने वाली त्रुटियों को संदर्भित करता है। जबकि यह एक प्रकार की मानवीय त्रुटि है, इसे स्विचिंग त्रुटि के रूप में वर्गीकृत नहीं किया गया है। स्विचिंग त्रुटियां विशेष रूप से अनुचित कनेक्शन या कॉन्फ़िगरेशन से संबंधित हैं।

विकल्प 3: गर्मी के कारण त्रुटि।

question: Which of the following devices enables people in a submarine to observe above water surface?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उपकरण पनडुब्बी में लोगों को पानी की सतह के ऊपर निरीक्षण करने में सक्षम बनाता है?
solution:
The Correct answer is Periscope.

Key Points

  • A periscope is an optical device used to observe objects that are not in the direct line of sight.
  • It is particularly useful in submarines, allowing crew members to view the surface above the water while remaining submerged.
  • The device works using a system of mirrors or prisms that reflect light through a tube.
  • Submarine periscopes typically have two mirrors, positioned at 45-degree angles, enabling the user to see the scene above the water.
  • Modern periscopes integrate advanced features such as cameras, electronic displays, and infrared technology to enhance visibility.
  • Periscopes are also used in other applications, such as in tanks, bunkers, and for military surveillance.
  • The invention of the periscope is attributed to the French physicist Jules Carpentier and the Swedish inventor Theo Nordenfelt.

Additional Information

  • Telescope
    • A telescope is an optical instrument designed to observe distant objects, such as stars and planets.
    • It uses a combination of lenses and mirrors to magnify distant objects and is widely used in astronomy.
    • Unlike a periscope, a telescope is not designed for observing objects that are hidden or obstructed.
  • Stethoscope
    • A stethoscope is a medical device used by healthcare professionals to listen to sounds within the human body, such as heartbeat, lung sounds, and bowel sounds.
    • It is not related to optical devices or observations above water surfaces.
  • Kaleidoscope
    • A kaleidoscope is an optical toy that creates symmetrical patterns by reflecting light off mirrors and colored objects inside a tube.
    • It is mainly used for entertainment and artistic purposes, rather than practical observation.

question: What instrument is used to measure lung volumes during breathing?
question_hi: सांस लेने के दौरान फेफड़ों के आयतन को मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
solution:
The Correct answer is Spirometer.

Key Points

  • A spirometer is an instrument used to measure the volume of air inhaled and exhaled by the lungs during breathing.
  • It is commonly used in pulmonary function tests (PFTs) to diagnose and monitor lung conditions such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and other respiratory disorders.
  • The device helps evaluate how well the lungs are working by assessing parameters like forced expiratory volume (FEV) and vital capacity (VC).
  • It is a non-invasive and safe method for monitoring lung health and is widely used in clinical settings.
  • Spirometry tests can also be used to track the progress of respiratory therapy and detect early signs of lung diseases.
  • The spirometer works by capturing the air flow during breathing and converting it into measurable data to analyze lung function.
  • Modern spirometers are equipped with digital technology for accurate results and real-time monitoring.

Additional Information

  • Respirometer
    • A respirometer is used to measure the rate of respiration in organisms.
    • It is typically used in biology experiments to study the oxygen uptake and carbon dioxide production in plants or animals.
    • Respirometers are not used for measuring lung volumes but are instead designed for metabolic studies.
  • Sphygmomanometer
    • A sphygmomanometer is a medical instrument used to measure blood pressure.
    • It consists of a cuff, a pressure gauge, and a stethoscope or electronic sensor.
    • It is widely used for diagnosing hypertension and monitoring cardiovascular health.
  • Barometer
    • A barometer measures atmospheric pressure and is commonly used in meteorology.
    • It helps predict weather conditions and is not related to measuring lung volumes or respiratory functions.
    • Barometers come in various types, such as mercury barometers and aneroid barometers.

question: What is the name of the medical instrument used to listen to internal body sounds, especially from the heart and lungs?
question_hi: शरीर की आंतरिक ध्वनियों, विशेष रूप से हृदय और फेफड़ों से आने वाली ध्वनियों को सुनने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले चिकित्सा उपकरण का नाम क्या है?
solution:
The correct answer is Stethoscope.

Key Points

  • Stethoscope: The stethoscope is a medical instrument used by healthcare professionals to listen to internal body sounds, particularly from the heart, lungs, and blood vessels.
  • It is widely used for diagnostic purposes, helping doctors identify abnormalities such as irregular heartbeats, breathing difficulties, or other internal issues.
  • The stethoscope typically consists of earpieces, a tubing system, and a chest piece that includes a diaphragm and/or bell, which amplifies sounds from the body. Hence, the statement about stethoscope is correct.
  • It was invented in 1816 by the French physician René Laennec, who initially created a wooden tube to amplify body sounds.
  • Modern stethoscopes are available in various types, including acoustic stethoscopes, electronic stethoscopes, and even smart stethoscopes that can record and analyze sounds digitally. Hence, the functionality of stethoscope is accurate.
  • The stethoscope remains an essential tool in healthcare settings for performing routine check-ups, monitoring chronic conditions, and conducting emergency assessments.

Additional Information

  • Other Medical Instruments:
    • Endoscope: Used to examine the interior of hollow organs or cavities within the body, such as the digestive tract, using a flexible tube with a camera. It is primarily used for diagnostic imaging and surgeries.
    • Barometer: Not a medical instrument, but a device used to measure atmospheric pressure, often employed in weather forecasting.
    • Colonoscope: A specialized endoscope used to examine the colon and rectum for abnormalities such as polyps, cancer, or inflammation.
  • Historical Context:
    • The invention of the stethoscope marked a turning point in the field of medicine, providing physicians with a tool to directly assess internal body sounds without invasive procedures.
    • René Laennec initially used a wooden tube, later evolving into the modern stethoscope equipped with advanced features like noise reduction and sound amplification.
  • Modern Innovations:
    • Electronic stethoscopes are now integrated with Bluetooth and AI technology for precise diagnoses.
    • Smart stethoscopes can store patient data and provide real-time analysis, aiding in better healthcare delivery.

Important Points

  • Applications of Stethoscope:
    • Used for diagnosing cardiovascular conditions by listening to heartbeats and murmurs.
    • Essential for assessing lung health, detecting abnormalities like wheezing or crackling sounds.
    • In neonatal care, stethoscopes are used to monitor the health of newborns.
  • Technological Advancements:
    • Smart stethoscopes reduce ambient noise, enhancing sound clarity for accurate diagnosis.
    • Integration with telemedicine platforms allows remote patient monitoring.

Additional Information

question: Relationship between °C (Centigrade) and °F (Fahrenheit) is C * 9/5 + 32 = F Normal temperature of a human body is 98.6°F. In term of °C, it is:
question_hi: सेल्सियस (°C) और फ़ारेनहाइट (°F) के बीच संबंध C * 9/5 + 32 = F है। मानव शरीर का सामान्य तापमान 98.6°F है। इसे °C में व्यक्त करें:
solution:
The Correct answer is 37ºC

Key Points

  • The relationship between °C (Centigrade) and °F (Fahrenheit) is given by the formula: F = C × 9/5 + 32.
  • To convert the normal temperature of a human body, which is 98.6°F, into °C, the formula is rearranged as: C = (F - 32) × 5/9.
  • Substituting F = 98.6: C = (98.6 - 32) × 5/9 = 66.6 × 5/9 = 37°C.
  • The correct answer is 37°C, which matches the normal body temperature when expressed in degrees Celsius.
  • This formula is widely used in scientific measurements and medical fields to convert temperatures between the two scales.
  • It is important to understand this conversion as temperature measurements may vary depending on the system used in different countries or contexts.

Additional Information

  • Important Notes on Temperature Conversion:
    • The Fahrenheit scale is primarily used in the United States, whereas the Celsius scale is used in most other countries.
    • The normal body temperature in Fahrenheit is generally accepted to be 98.6°F, but it can vary slightly depending on individual conditions.
    • The Celsius scale is based on the properties of water, with 0°C as the freezing point and 100°C as the boiling point at sea level.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर 37ºC है। 

Key Points

  • °C (सेल्सियस) और °F (फ़ारेनहाइट) के बीच संबंध इस सूत्र द्वारा दिया गया है: F = C × 9/5 + 32.
  • मानव शरीर के सामान्य तापमान, जो 98.6°F है, को °C में बदलने के लिए, सूत्र को इस प्रकार पुनर्व्यवस्थित किया जाता है: C = (F - 32) × 5/9
  • F = 98.6 रखने पर: C = (98.6 - 32) × 5/9 = 66.6 × 5/9 = 37°C
  • सही उत्तर 37°C है, जो सेल्सियस डिग्री में व्यक्त सामान्य शरीर के तापमान से मेल खाता है।
  • यह सूत्र वैज्ञानिक माप और चिकित्सा क्षेत्रों में दो पैमानों के बीच तापमान को बदलने के लिए व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।
  • इस रूपांतरण को समझना महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि विभिन्न देशों या संदर्भों में उपयोग की जाने वाली प्रणाली के आधार पर तापमान माप भिन्न हो सकते हैं।

Additional Information

  • तापमान रूपांतरण पर महत्वपूर्ण नोट्स:
    • फ़ारेनहाइट पैमाना मुख्यतः संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में उपयोग किया जाता है जबकि सेल्सियस पैमाना अधिकांश अन्य देशों में उपयोग किया जाता है।
    • फ़ारेनहाइट में सामान्य शरीर का तापमान प्रायः 98.6°F माना जाता है, लेकिन यह व्यक्तिगत परिस्थितियों के आधार पर थोड़ा भिन्न हो सकता है।
    • सेल्सियस पैमाना पानी के गुणों पर आधारित है, जिसमें 0°C हिमांक और समुद्र तल पर 100°C क्वथनांक है।

question: In image steganography the term LSB stands for
question_hi: छवि स्टेग्नोग्राफ़ी में LSB शब्द का अर्थ है
solution:
The correct answer is Least Significant Bit.

Key Points

  • In image steganography, Least Significant Bit (LSB) is a common technique used to hide information within digital images.
  • The LSB method modifies the least significant bit of image pixel values to encode secret data, ensuring minimal visible distortion in the image.
  • It is highly effective for hiding large amounts of data while maintaining the quality of the image.
  • It works best with uncompressed images (like BMP or PNG) as compressed formats (like JPEG) may distort the hidden data during compression.
  • LSB steganography is widely used in secure communication and watermarking applications.

Additional Information

  • Steganography:
    • It is the practice of concealing messages or information within other non-secret data, such as images, videos, or audio files.
    • Unlike encryption, the existence of the hidden information is not apparent.
    • Steganography is used in areas like digital watermarking and secure communication.
  • Other Steganography Techniques:
    • Pixel Value Differencing (PVD): Modifies pixel values in an image to embed data.
    • Transform Domain Techniques: Hides data in frequency coefficients obtained from transformations like DCT or DWT.
    • Audio Steganography: Embeds information into audio files using techniques like echo hiding or phase coding.
  • Advantages of LSB Steganography:
    • Easy to implement and requires minimal computational resources.
    • Provides high imperceptibility, as changes in pixel values are negligible.
  • Limitations of LSB:
    • Vulnerable to image manipulation, such as cropping or resizing, which can disrupt the hidden data.
    • Offers less security compared to advanced techniques, as attackers may easily decode the hidden information.

Additional Information

  • स्टीगोग्राफी:
    • यह अन्य गैर-गुप्त डेटा, जैसे छवियां, वीडियो या ऑडियो फ़ाइलों के भीतर संदेशों या सूचनाओं को छिपाने का अभ्यास है।
    • एन्क्रिप्शन के विपरीत, छिपी हुई जानकारी का अस्तित्व स्पष्ट नहीं है।
    • स्टीगोग्राफी का उपयोग डिजिटल वॉटरमार्किंग और सुरक्षित संचार जैसे क्षेत्रों में किया जाता है।
  • अन्य स्टीगोग्राफी तकनीकें:

    • उच्च अपरिवर्तनीयता प्रदान करता है, क्योंकि पिक्सेल मानों में परिवर्तन नगण्य होते हैं।
  • LSB की सीमाएँ:
    • छवि हेरफेर के प्रति संवेदनशील, जैसे कि क्रॉपिंग या आकार बदलना, जो छिपे हुए डेटा को बाधित कर सकता है।
    • उन्नत तकनीकों की तुलना में कम सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है, क्योंकि हमलावर आसानी से छिपी हुई जानकारी को डिकोड कर सकते हैं।

question: On which instrument are the earthquake waves recorded?
question_hi: किस यंत्र पर भूकंप की लहरें दर्ज की जाती हैं ?
solution:
The correct answer is Seismograph.

Key Points

  • A seismograph is an instrument used to detect and record earthquake waves, including primary (P), secondary (S), and surface waves.
  • It measures the motion of the ground during an earthquake and translates it into a graphical representation called a seismogram.
  • Seismographs are sensitive to ground vibrations and are commonly installed at seismic stations worldwide to monitor earthquake activity.
  • The first modern seismograph was invented by John Milne in the late 19th century, improving the detection of seismic waves.
  • Seismic data collected by seismographs are essential for analyzing earthquake magnitude, depth, and location, aiding disaster preparedness and mitigation efforts.

Additional Information

  • Richter Scale:
    • The Richter scale measures the magnitude of an earthquake, which is the energy released at its source.
    • Developed in 1935 by Charles F. Richter, it uses logarithmic values, meaning each whole number increase represents a tenfold increase in amplitude.
    • While widely known, it has been largely replaced by the Moment Magnitude Scale for greater accuracy.
  • Mercalli Scale:
    • It measures the intensity of an earthquake, indicating its effects on people, buildings, and the environment.
    • The Mercalli scale ranges from I (not felt) to XII (total destruction).
    • Unlike the Richter scale, it is based on observational data rather than instrumentation.
  • Types of Seismic Waves:
    • Primary waves (P-waves): Fastest seismic waves, traveling through solids, liquids, and gases.
    • Secondary waves (S-waves): Slower than P-waves, traveling only through solids.
    • Surface waves: Slowest waves, causing the most damage due to their high amplitude.
  • Moment Magnitude Scale:
    • It is the most accurate scale for measuring the energy released during an earthquake.
    • Used by seismologists globally to replace the Richter scale for major earthquakes.
    • Provides a comprehensive view of earthquake size by considering fault dimensions and displacement.

मुख्य बिंदु

Additional Information

    • द्वितीयक तरंगें (S-तरंगें): P-तरंगों से धीमी, केवल ठोसों से होकर गुजरती हैं।
    • सतह तरंगें: सबसे धीमी तरंगें, जो अपने उच्च आयाम के कारण सबसे अधिक नुकसान पहुंचाती हैं।
  • मोमेंट मैग्नीट्यूड स्केल:
    • यह भूकंप के दौरान जारी ऊर्जा को मापने के लिए सबसे सटीक पैमाना है।
    • प्रमुख भूकंपों के लिए रिएक्टर स्केल को बदलने के लिए वैश्विक स्तर पर भूकंप विज्ञानियों द्वारा उपयोग किया जाता है।
    • दोष आयामों और विस्थापन को ध्यान में रखते हुए भूकंप के आकार का एक व्यापक दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करता है।

question: <!-- x-tinymce/html -->For seeing objects at the surface of water from a submarine under water, the instrument used is
question_hi: <!-- x-tinymce/html -->पानी के नीचे पनडुब्बी से पानी की सतह पर वस्तुओं को देखने के लिए, किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
solution:
The correct answer is Periscope.

Key Points

  • A periscope is an optical instrument used to observe objects that are not directly visible due to obstacles or distance.
  • It is commonly used in submarines for viewing objects at the surface of the water while remaining underwater.
  • The periscope works on the principle of light reflection through mirrors or prisms positioned at precise angles.
  • Modern periscopes in submarines are equipped with advanced features such as night vision, thermal imaging, and electronic displays for enhanced observation.
  • Besides submarines, periscopes are widely used in tanks, armored vehicles, and observation tools for military and educational purposes.

Additional Information

  • Reflection of Light:
    • The periscope operates on the principle of reflection, where the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
    • Mirrors or prisms are arranged at specific angles to redirect light to the observer's eye, ensuring clear visibility.
  • Uses in Submarines:
    • Submarines utilize periscopes to monitor the surface for navigation, threats, or communication signals while staying hidden underwater.
    • Modern submarine periscopes include cameras, laser rangefinders, and sensors to improve functionality.
    • They can be retracted when not in use for stealth and protection.
  • Other Applications:
    • Periscopes are employed in tanks and armored vehicles for battlefield observation.
    • They are used in scientific experiments to demonstrate optical principles.
    • Educational tools use periscopes to teach students about light and reflection.
  • Historical Context:
    • The modern periscope was invented by Sir Howard Grubb in the late 19th century.
    • Periscopes became widely used during World War I and II for military purposes.
    • Over time, their design has evolved significantly, incorporating advanced technologies for better observation.

question: Potometer is used to measure:
question_hi: पोटोमीटर का उपयोग ________ को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
solution:
The Correct answer is Transpiration.

Key Points

  • A potometer is an instrument used to measure the rate of water uptake by a plant, which is closely related to the rate of transpiration.
  • Transpiration is the process by which plants lose water vapor through their stomata, primarily in their leaves.
  • The potometer works on the principle that the amount of water lost by transpiration is equal to the amount of water absorbed by the plant.
  • It typically consists of a water reservoir, a plant specimen, and a graduated scale to measure water movement.
  • Factors affecting transpiration include temperature, humidity, wind speed, and light intensity, all of which can influence measurements taken with a potometer.
  • Using a potometer allows scientists to study how environmental conditions impact plant water loss, aiding in agricultural research and conservation.

Additional Information

  • Photosynthesis
    • Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water to produce glucose and oxygen.
    • A potometer is not used to measure photosynthesis; instead, devices like oxygen electrodes or gas exchange systems are used.
  • Ascent of Sap
    • The ascent of sap refers to the upward movement of water and minerals from roots to leaves through the plant's xylem tissue.
    • This phenomenon is studied using techniques like tracer experiments or pressure chambers, not a potometer.
  • Root Pressure
    • Root pressure is the force that pushes water upward from the roots to the xylem vessels of plants.
    • It is measured using devices like manometers, not potometers.

question: The instrument used to measure high temperature from a long distance is _______.
question_hi: उच्च तापमान को अधिक दूरी से नापने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला उपकरण________ है
solution:
The Correct answer is Pyrometer.

Key Points

  • A Pyrometer is a type of non-contact device used to measure high temperatures from a distance.
  • It works by detecting the thermal radiation emitted by an object and converting it into a temperature reading.
  • Pyrometers are commonly used in industries such as metallurgy, manufacturing, and glass production, where measuring extremely high temperatures is critical.
  • They are capable of measuring temperatures typically above the range of conventional thermometers, often reaching up to thousands of degrees Celsius.
  • Pyrometers are especially useful in situations where direct contact with the object is not feasible due to extreme heat or hazardous conditions.
  • Modern pyrometers often utilize infrared technology to detect temperature, providing accurate readings quickly and efficiently.
  • There are two main types of pyrometers: optical pyrometers and infrared pyrometers, each having specific applications.
  • Pyrometers are used for monitoring processes such as heat treatment, forging, and furnace operations.

Additional Information

  • Thermometer
    • A Thermometer is a device primarily used to measure moderate temperatures, typically in environments such as homes, hospitals, or laboratories.
    • It is not suitable for measuring extremely high temperatures from a distance.
    • Thermometers come in different types, such as mercury thermometers, alcohol thermometers, digital thermometers, and infrared thermometers.
  • Spectrometer
    • A Spectrometer is an instrument used to measure properties of light, such as its wavelength and intensity.
    • It is primarily used in fields like astronomy, chemistry, and physics for analyzing spectra and does not measure temperature directly.
  • Radiometer
    • A Radiometer is an instrument used to measure the intensity or power of electromagnetic radiation, such as light or heat.
    • Although radiometers can measure radiation, they are not specifically designed for measuring high temperatures from a distance.

  • रेडियोमीटर
    • एक रेडियोमीटर एक उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग विद्युत चुम्बकीय विकिरण की तीव्रता या शक्ति को मापने के लिए किया जाता है, जैसे कि प्रकाश या गर्मी।

question: Wind velocity is measured by -

solution:

question: Which of the following is present in the thermometer?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन थर्मामीटर में मौजूद है?
solution:
The correct answer is Mercury.

Key Points

  • Mercury is a liquid metal that is commonly used in thermometers due to its unique physical properties.
  • It has a high coefficient of thermal expansion, meaning it expands uniformly with temperature changes, making it ideal for measuring temperature accurately.
  • Mercury remains in a liquid state over a wide temperature range, from -39°C to 356°C, covering the range typically required for thermometers. Hence, mercury is used in thermometers.
  • Mercury’s shiny and reflective surface makes it easy to read the temperature scale on the thermometer.
  • It does not stick to the walls of the thermometer tube, ensuring precise readings and smooth movement inside the capillary tube.
  • Other substances like milk of magnesia, bromine solution, and hard water are not suitable for thermometers due to their physical and chemical properties. Hence, only mercury is used in thermometers.

Additional Information

  • Properties of Mercury:
    • Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature (25°C).
    • It has a density of 13.6 g/cm³, making it highly compact and suitable for various applications, including thermometers and barometers.
    • Mercury is a good conductor of heat, which ensures accurate temperature measurements in thermometers.
  • Safety Concerns:
    • Mercury is toxic if ingested or inhaled, which is why its use in medical and household thermometers is declining.
    • Many countries are shifting to alcohol-based or digital thermometers as safer alternatives.
  • Alternative Substances:
    • Alcohol-based thermometers use dyed alcohol and are often used for measuring lower temperatures.
    • Digital thermometers use electronic sensors to measure temperature accurately and are considered safer than mercury thermometers.

Important Points

  • Comparison of Different Options:
    • Milk of Magnesia: It is used as an antacid and laxative, not suitable for measuring temperature.
    • Bromine Solution: A corrosive substance used in chemical processes, not applicable for thermometers.
    • Hard Water: Contains dissolved minerals like calcium and magnesium, making it unsuitable for precise temperature measurement.
  • Historical Context:
    • Gabriel Fahrenheit developed the mercury thermometer in 1714.
    • Mercury thermometers were widely used until the rise of digital thermometers in the 21st century.

question: Which of the following measures the magnitude of an earthquake?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भूकंप की तीव्रता को मापता है?
solution:
The correct answer is Richter scale.

Key Points

  • The Richter scale is a logarithmic scale used to measure the magnitude of earthquakes.
  • It was developed in 1935 by Charles F. Richter, a seismologist, in collaboration with Beno Gutenberg.
  • The scale quantifies the amount of energy released during an earthquake.
  • It is based on measurements of the amplitude of seismic waves recorded by a seismograph.
  • The scale is logarithmic, meaning each whole number increase represents a tenfold increase in amplitude and approximately 31.6 times more energy release.
  • The Richter scale is suitable for measuring the magnitude of small to medium earthquakes but is not as effective for very large earthquakes.
  • This scale is essential for seismologists to assess the intensity of an earthquake and its potential impact.

Additional Information

  • Explanation of Other Options:
    • Polygraph: Also known as a lie detector, it measures physiological responses such as heart rate, blood pressure, and respiration to assess truthfulness. It is not related to earthquake measurement.
    • Barometer: This instrument is used to measure atmospheric pressure. It is commonly used in weather forecasting but has no connection to earthquake magnitude.
    • Thermometer: A thermometer measures temperature, whether it is of the environment, human body, or any other system. It is irrelevant to seismology.
  • Richter Scale Characteristics:
    • The scale ranges from 1 to 10, where values below 2 are typically not felt by humans, and values above 7 represent major earthquakes with potential for significant destruction.
    • The largest earthquake ever recorded on the Richter scale was the 1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile, with a magnitude of 9.5.
  • Modern Advances:
    • While the Richter scale is historically significant, modern seismologists use the Moment Magnitude Scale (Mw), which provides more accurate measurements of large earthquakes.
    • Both scales are logarithmic and are consistent for small to medium earthquakes.

Important Points

  • Seismographs:
    • These instruments are used to record seismic waves generated by earthquakes.
    • Seismographs detect ground motion and create a visual representation called a seismogram.
  • Earthquake Preparedness:
    • Knowing the magnitude and location of an earthquake helps in disaster management and preparedness.
    • Countries like Japan and the United States have advanced seismic monitoring systems to mitigate earthquake-related risks.

    • सीस्मोग्राफ जमीन की गति का पता लगाते हैं और एक दृश्य प्रतिनिधित्व बनाते हैं जिसे सीस्मोग्राम कहा जाता है।

question: Relative density is measured by _______.
question_hi: आपेक्षिक घनत्‍व को _______ से मापा जाता है।
solution:
The Correct answer is Hydrometer.

Key Points

  • A hydrometer is an instrument used to measure the relative density (also called specific gravity) of liquids.
  • The relative density is determined by the ratio of the density of the liquid to the density of water.
  • It works on the principle of Archimedes' Principle, which states that a body submerged in a fluid experiences an upward buoyant force equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by it.
  • A typical hydrometer consists of a weighted, sealed glass tube with a scale inside it.
  • When the hydrometer is floated in a liquid, the level at which it settles corresponds to the relative density of the liquid, which can be read from the calibrated scale.
  • Hydrometers are used in various applications, such as measuring the density of battery acid, alcohol, or milk.
  • They are critical tools in industries like brewing, winemaking, and chemical manufacturing.

 Additional Information

  • Galvanometer
    • A galvanometer is an instrument used to detect and measure small electric currents.
    • It works on the principle of deflection of a coil in the presence of a magnetic field when current passes through it.
    • It is commonly used in laboratories for electrical experiments.
  • Lactometer
    • A lactometer is used to measure the purity of milk by determining its density.
    • It is designed to float in milk, and its calibrated scale indicates the milk's density, helping detect adulteration like added water.
  • Pendulum
    • A pendulum is a device consisting of a mass (bob) suspended from a fixed point, capable of swinging freely under the influence of gravity.
    • Pendulums are primarily used to measure time in clocks and for scientific experiments to determine properties like acceleration due to gravity.

  • एक हाइड्रोमीटर एक ऐसा उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग द्रवों के सापेक्ष घनत्व (जिसे विशिष्ट गुरुत्व भी कहा जाता है) को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
  • सापेक्ष घनत्व द्रव के घनत्व के पानी के घनत्व के अनुपात से निर्धारित होता है।
  • यह आर्किमिडीज के सिद्धांत के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है, जो कहता है कि एक द्रव में डूबे हुए पिंड पर एक ऊपर की ओर उत्प्लावन बल लगता है जो उसके द्वारा विस्थापित द्रव के भार के बराबर होता है।
  • एक विशिष्ट हाइड्रोमीटर में एक भारित, सीलबंद कांच की नली होती है जिसमें एक पैमाना होता है।
  • जब हाइड्रोमीटर को किसी द्रव में तैराया जाता है, तो जिस स्तर पर यह बसता है वह द्रव के सापेक्ष घनत्व से मेल खाता है, जिसे कैलिब्रेटेड स्केल से पढ़ा जा सकता है।
  • हाइड्रोमीटर का उपयोग विभिन्न अनुप्रयोगों में किया जाता है, जैसे कि बैटरी एसिड, अल्कोहल या दूध के घनत्व को मापना।
  • वे ब्रुइंग, वाइनमेकिंग और रासायनिक निर्माण जैसे उद्योगों में महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण हैं।

Additional Information

  • गैल्वेनोमीटर
    • एक गैल्वेनोमीटर एक ऐसा उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग छोटी विद्युत धाराओं का पता लगाने और मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
    • यह एक चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की उपस्थिति में एक कुंडल के विक्षेपण के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है जब उसमें से धारा गुजरती है।
    • यह आमतौर पर प्रयोगशालाओं में विद्युत प्रयोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
  • लैक्टोमीटर
    • एक लैक्टोमीटर का उपयोग इसके घनत्व का निर्धारण करके दूध की शुद्धता को मापने के लिए किया जाता है।
    • इसे दूध में तैरने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, और इसका कैलिब्रेटेड स्केल दूध के घनत्व को इंगित करता है, जिससे मिलावट जैसे कि पानी मिलाना पता चलता है।
  • लोलक
    • एक लोलक एक ऐसा उपकरण है जिसमें एक द्रव्यमान (बॉब) होता है जो एक निश्चित बिंदु से निलंबित होता है, जो गुरुत्वाकर्षण के प्रभाव में स्वतंत्र रूप से झूलने में सक्षम होता है।
    • लोलक का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से घड़ियों में समय मापने और वैज्ञानिक प्रयोगों के लिए गुरुत्वाकर्षण के कारण त्वरण जैसे गुणों को निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है।
